title: The ZCC v2 API: RESTful paths, offset paging and the list envelope

prose.text: Three ZCC object families have a v2 API under `/zcc/papi/public/v2`: notification templates, ZIA posture profiles and trusted networks. Only the Go SDK and the Terraform provider call them; the Python SDK and the captured contract do not cover them.

How the Go helper walks pages, and where it can skip records or loop, is in [[shared.sdk-go.list-pagination:zcc-skip-advances-by-requested-size]] and [[shared.sdk-go.list-pagination:zcc-guards-need-envelope-metadata]]. The page size the Go SDK sends is its own: [[shared.sdk-go.list-pagination:zcc-v2-page-size]]. What the server caps or defaults is open [[shared.sdk-go.list-pagination:zcc-v2-envelope-behavior]].
{{contract-lacks-v2}} Whether v2 replaces the v1 endpoints is open [[zcc.api.trusted-networks-wire:v1-v2-coexistence]].

checks.do: Whether the tenant serves the v2 family at all, from the status of a one-item list call, before debugging a v2 object read.
Whether a v2 list was paged with `skip` and `perPage` and read from `items`, not with v1's `page` and `pageSize`.

offset-query.statement: The Go SDK pages v2 lists by offset with the query parameters `skip` and `perPage`, searches with `keyword`, and adds per-family filters: `type` for trusted networks and `platformType` for ZIA posture profiles.

list-envelope.statement: The Go SDK's model says every v2 list endpoint wraps its records in an object with `items`, `total`, `offset`, `limit` and `count`, unlike the v1 lists, which it describes as bare JSON arrays.

quotes: the v1 endpoints — which return a bare JSON array — every v2 list endpoint // wraps the records in an object that also carries pagination metadata

list-envelope.conditions: The v1 trusted-network list is an exception the SDKs themselves read as an object; see zcc.api.trusted-networks-wire.

name-lookup-substring.statement: The Go SDK says the v2 `keyword` search is a substring match, so its lookups by name for notification templates, ZIA posture profiles and trusted networks narrow by keyword on the server and then compare names case-insensitively on the client.

posture-shape.statement: A v2 ZIA posture profile as the Go SDK models it has an integer `id`, a `name`, an integer `platform`, and three trust levels (`highTrustCriteria`, `mediumTrustCriteria`, `lowTrustCriteria`), each a `cs` array of criteria sets whose `cn` arrays hold criteria with `id`, `name` and `udid`.

posture-platform-filter.statement: The Go SDK says the ZIA posture list's `platformType` filter selects a device platform, with 0 meaning all platforms.
posture-platform-filter.conditions: Narrowed per verifier: the Go comment does not name the codes 1 to 5.

quotes: // PlatformType filters by device platform (0 = all platforms).

notification-template-shape.statement: A v2 notification template as the Go SDK models it uses JSON booleans for its toggles and nests ZIA and ZPA settings in `ziaNotificationTemplate` and `zpaNotificationTemplate`, unlike the `notificationTemplateContract` block inside an iOS web policy, whose 0/1 flags are quoted strings.

quotes: block the iOS web policy carries at the WebPolicy root.

contract-lacks-v2.statement: The captured Automate contract has no operations for notification templates or ZIA posture profiles, though the Terraform provider manages both as resources.

quotes: `zcc_notification_template` and `zcc_zia_posture` are Terraform Plugin Framework resources, but no matching captured Automate contract operations are present in `zcc-api-reference.json`.
